messages:
Rae Chen: Kickoff for Nucleus Health onboarding. High-level goal: pilot in 30 days, confirm success metrics & any early renewal risks. Quick owners? :wave:
Tom Brooks: I'll take API integration + IP allowlist + auth flow. Will run an auth dry-run by day 3. Note: customer asked for IP allowlist and webhook signing.
Leila Hassan: I'll run enablement and the playbook. Suggest two short sessions (45m): integration walkthrough (wk1) and prompt tuning + evals (wk2). I'll prepare a lightweight playbook doc.
Gus Park: I'll own infra and SLAs. Proposed pilot targets: p95 latency < 300ms, p99 < 800ms, API uptime >= 99.5%. Also set a pilot spend cap: $3k. Will add alerts for spend > 80%.
Rae Chen: I asked for SOC2/DPA and a sample of 20 typical requests in the welcome email. Also asked for exec sponsor intro; procurement window might be ~45 days which is a potential renewal risk.
Tom Brooks: Action item for customer: send sample payloads, and confirm which IPs need allowlist. I'll post the webhook signing spec in the repo.
Leila Hassan: Enablement checklist v0:
- Day 0: intros + roles
- Day 2: API walkthrough + webhook signing
- Day 7: prompt design + 10-case pre/post eval
- Day 12: failover & incident runbook
- Day 30: pilot review + renewal discussion
I'll upload slides and the playbook page after session 1.
Gus Park: Data note: if payloads include PHI, we'll require minimization and an encryption-at-rest/KMS plan. I'll draft options and required IAM roles in the ticket.
Rae Chen: Risk summary: renewal-risk: medium (procurement cadence long), exec-sponsor: unconfirmed, integration-complexity: low. We should push for exec intro by day 7.
Tom Brooks: I'll do the smoke auth + request by day 3 and share examples here.
Leila Hassan: We'll run a 10-case prompt regression pre/post any config changes and keep results in the shared doc. Also proposing weekly 30-min feedback sync during pilot.
OnboardBot: Meeting created: "Nucleus Health - Onboarding Kickoff" on 2025-12-09 10:00 PST (invite sent).
Rae Chen: Recap of owners:
- Rae: exec intro + chase SOC2/DPA (today)
- Tom: integration dry-run + webhook spec (day 3)
- Leila: enablement sessions + eval set (wk1)
- Gus: infra SLA + spend alerts (48h)
If blockers appear, post here and I'll escalate. :eyes:
